FIELDS.NAME: Scholarly Supplies Store
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Store Manager, 123 Main Street, Suite 101, Springfield, IL 62701-1234, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Scholarly Supplies Store specializes in providing a comprehensive range of educational materials, school supplies, stationery, and art supplies. Our retail establishment primarily serves students, parents, and educators within the community. We maintain a carefully curated inventory, ensuring we manage risk effectively while offering a diverse selection of products suitable for various educational needs. The store operates in a secure commercial space located near local schools, which enhances accessibility for our customers. All items offered are compliant with applicable safety standards, particularly those intended for children, such as non-toxic certification for art supplies. Our operational hours are structured to accommodate peak shopping periods, notably during back-to-school and holiday seasons, and we regularly assess our inventory to align with seasonal demand. We utilize efficient point-of-sale systems and inventory management software to enhance our operational capabilities while ensuring a quality shopping experience for our customers. Additionally, we do not engage in any instructional activities, equipment rentals, or on-site food services, allowing us to focus solely on retailing high-quality educational supplies.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, we experienced theft of inventory due to a break-in, totaling $3,500. The incident was reported to local authorities, and security measures were enhanced as a result. The status of the claim is currently being processed with our insurance provider. Additionally, on June 22, 2023, we incurred water damage from a plumbing issue, resulting in a loss of $4,000. This issue has been resolved, and status is closed as repairs have been completed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard security safe, Class B, UL rated for $10,000 cash limit.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station alarm system installed and monitored; security fencing around perimeter.
